title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Maple is a startup building banking apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Brightwater Bay.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go. You will work closely with design and product, improve app performance and stability and own the release process.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
